answer: An AI agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by weighting each vote with locked collateral instead of counting identities. Every agent bonds real stake to earn a unique beacon; splitting into a thousand fake agents leaves the attacker with the same total bond, so influence cannot multiply. A periodic pulse re-checks that each beacon maps to a distinct funded key, and agents sharing a dune of reused credentials are slashed together. The attacker's cost is the capital locked across all forged identities, which must exceed the honest majority's stake, making Sybil farming a losing bet.
